facts.fact: Kenya News Agency reports that on 2026-07-29 Kenya and Tanzania ministers launched at the Lunga Lunga/Horohoro border a cross-border project joining Kenya's national broadband backbone and submarine cable infrastructure with Tanzania's, implemented by Kenya's ICT Authority and TTCL; it does not say the link is lit.

systems.platform: national broadband backbone fibre (NICTBB) joined to Tanzanian backbone and submarine cable
